name: Hyros Tracking
author: Hyros

sections.description:
Unlock unparalleled insights with the Hyros Tracking plugin. This essential tool seamlessly integrates the powerful Hyros tracking script into your online store, designed specifically for WordPress & WooCommerce users. Easily capture comprehensive customer navigation data, understand user behavior patterns, and gain a clear view of your sales.

By leveraging Hyros analytics, you can optimize your marketing strategies, personalize customer experiences, and make data-driven decisions to significantly boost your conversion rates and overall revenue. The plugin offers straightforward setup, ensuring that you can start collecting valuable customer journey data without any technical hassle.
sections.installation: Upload the Hyros plugin to your WordPress/WooCommerce site, activate it, and configure your tracking script from Hyros tracking dashboard.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with WooCommerce?

Yes, this plugin is designed to integrate with WooCommerce.
